parameters.content:
## Inventory Stock Alert (Indonesia)

### Monitors:
- 🔴 **Stok Habis** — Zero stock items
- 🟡 **Stok Rendah** — Below minimum threshold
- ⏰ **Mendekati Kadaluarsa** — Expiring within 30 days
- 📈 **Overstock** — Above maximum threshold

### Required Sheet columns:
kode_barang, nama_barang, kategori, stok, satuan, stok_minimum, stok_maksimum, harga_beli, supplier, lokasi_gudang, tanggal_kadaluarsa

### Outputs:
- Telegram alert (real-time to warehouse manager)
- Email to purchasing team (for reorder action)
